questions.questionText: What is the LCM of the co-prime numbers 11 and 34?
questions.explanation: 11 and 34 are co-prime (HCF = 1), so LCM = 11 × 34 = 374.

questions.questionText: The LCM of two numbers is 252. Which of the following pairs of numbers is co-prime with LCM exactly 252?
questions.explanation: A co-prime pair has LCM = product = 252 and HCF 1. 7 and 36 gives 7×36 = 252 with HCF 1. In the other pairs the HCF is greater than 1, so their LCM is smaller than the product.

questions.questionText: Two numbers are 20 and 36. Dividing each by their HCF gives two co-prime numbers. What is the sum of these co-prime numbers?
questions.explanation: HCF(20, 36) = 4. Quotients are 20/4 = 5 and 36/4 = 9, which are co-prime. Sum = 14.
questions.shortcut: Dividing by the HCF always leaves co-prime numbers.

questions.questionText: Two co-prime numbers have LCM 693. What is the smallest possible value of their sum?
questions.explanation: Co-prime ⇒ product = 693 with HCF 1. Co-prime factor pairs: (1, 693), (7, 99), (9, 77), (11, 63). Sums: 694, 106, 86, 74. Smallest = 74.
questions.shortcut: List co-prime factor pairs; the pair closest together gives the least sum.
